readings: For each account, average its transaction amounts (`trans.amount`), and assign the account to the region (`district.A3`) of its branch district (`account.district_id`). For each region, average those per-account averages to get the region's figure. For the regions whose figure is above the average across all regions, show each region, its figure, how much it exceeds the all-region average, and its figure divided by the average figure across all regions. Don't round anything.
queries:
WITH account_averages AS (
    SELECT a.account_id, d.A3 AS region, AVG(t.amount) AS account_average
    FROM account AS a
    JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
    LEFT JOIN trans AS t ON t.account_id = a.account_id
    GROUP BY a.account_id, d.A3
),
region_averages AS (
    SELECT region, AVG(account_average) AS figure
    FROM account_averages
    GROUP BY region
),
overall AS (
    SELECT AVG(figure) AS all_region_average
    FROM region_averages
)
SELECT r.region,
       r.figure,
       r.figure - o.all_region_average AS excess,
       r.figure / o.all_region_average AS ratio
FROM region_averages AS r
CROSS JOIN overall AS o
WHERE r.figure > o.all_region_average;
